title: Hunts FH-011S: Prove legacy check-in, reward and commerce paths are unchanged with every Hunt switch off

source.ref: Split from FH-011 (2026-11-10): the switches shipped; the legacy regression proof needs them wired into routes (FH-014 onward).

detail: Seed synthetic legacy rows, then show on an exact SHA that with every Hunt switch off the existing check-in, reward and commerce paths behave as before, plus observability and rollback proof. Done when: a test that exercises those three paths with all five switches off exists and passes, and the staging note records the SHA. Requires: FH-011, FH-014. Owner role: Release engineering.
